title: Zesty Syrian Lentil Soup
description: A light, fresh lentil soup with a bright twist of enchilada sauce and lemon, perfect for meal‑prep.

ingredients.name: Mixed spices
ingredients.notes: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper

instructions: Rinse the lentils under cold running water until the water runs clear; drain.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrot, celery, and minced garlic; sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the lentils, diced tomatoes, enchilada sauce, and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil.
Add the mixed spices, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the lentils are tender, about 20–25 minutes.
Optionally, use an immersion blender to partially blend the soup for a thicker texture, or leave it chunky.
Stir in the lemon juice. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Ladle the soup into bowls, garnish with chopped parsley, and serve hot or let cool for meal‑prep.
